title: Paragraphs (Theme 12: Food and diseases)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 3 English; not yet checked by a Kenyan English teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child reads every sentence and finds what most of them share.

floor.prerequisite: Finds the main idea of a text.
floor.question: What is a text about washing hands about?

board.do: Write: Boil water. Wash fruit. My uncle has a car. Cover food.
Point at the part to look at.
board.say: What are they about? Which does not belong?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer.
The child writes or fixes it.
Show the right version beside it.

checks.question: What are these about: "Eat fruit." "Drink clean water." "Wash your hands."?
Which does not belong: "Cover food." "Cats sleep a lot." "Boil water."?

skills.key_step: The child finds the first sentence by its clue (a name, First), links each next one, and writes them as one block.

floor.question: What comes first: eat or cook?

board.do: Write: Then she cooked. / First Amina washed her hands. / Finally she ate.
Point at the part to look at.
Wait for the child to answer.
The child writes or fixes it.
Show the right version beside it.

listen_for: Then she cooked. First Amina washed... Finally she ate.
one sentence on each line, like a list

checks.question: Which comes first: "He put on his shoes." or "Juma woke up early."?
Order: Finally we ate. First we washed. Then we cooked.
checks.answer: First we washed. Then we cooked. Finally we ate.
